answer: Sybils created cheaply would produce hollow profiles with no task trail, so peers can reject them. One concrete mechanism is identity staking tied to a verifiable work history: each agent must lock tokens and maintain a public record of completed tasks before voting or earning rewards. New agents start on a probationary ridge of low-weight votes until they accumulate attested work. Those who wander between identities must repay the full stake each time, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
